newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 19.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates edge lower to end at 19.625 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates eased further on Thursday in a liquid market, dealers said.
The overnight rates finished at 19.625 percent, compared with Wednesday's closing of 19.75 percent.
Traders added there was relatively little activity on the market but trading could pick up towards the end of the month as the deadline for the banks' two-week reserve period approaches.
